name: Primed Residue
desc: A unique and highly active form created by secretive means for Mages. Primed Residue is often black or purple and glows faintly. When consumed, it can swell a Mage's internal Reserve. Otherwise, this…

name: Pure Residue
desc: The common, wholesome, pale blue form recognizable in Plugs, Loops, and Spheres. This is simply Residue purged of impurities.

name: Infused Residue
desc: Violet-red and usually less vibrant, Infused Residue is created in Rituals that imbue it with some kind of Magical effect. This substance is valued for the effects it can cause, but little else, as t…

name: Corrupt Residue
sub: Natural Residues · Value: Half that of normal Residue.
desc: Blue-violet crystals that surge with a dark, internal energy. Corrupt Residue is a contaminated form saturated with Abyssal energy released in the Doom.

name: Elemental Residue
desc: A wider category of Residues that exhibit unusual properties aligned with a distinct Magical Aspect. Mage-Scholars theorize that these come about in regions with concentrations of natural substances…

name: Aether Residue
sub: Elemental Residues · Value: The same as Pure Residue.
desc: A paler blue than normal and shaped like thin, bright spikes. Aetheric Residue forms near high concentrations of Magic.

name: Space Residue
desc: Black with no inherent glow at all, Spatial Residue is usually found in clouds of dust blown by the winds of the Shard Sea. This is often used by Artificers to assess Relics and Artifacts, or to warn…

name: Time Residue
sub: Elemental Residues · Value: Ten times normal.
desc: Colorless and seemingly weightless crystals, Temporal Residue forms near ancient sites and has a strange relationship with memories and thought. Its most common use is as a kind of recording device.

name: Change Residue
desc: A white glowing liquid, Transient Residue seems to collect in or around regions of extreme Magical activity. This substance is intensely caustic, but has intrinsic properties that more than pay back…

name: Power Residue
sub: Elemental Residues · Value: Ten times normal.
desc: Red-hued and glowing, Primal Residue forms near regions of extreme heat and exudes constant powerful warmth, too hot to touch for any but a Forge Priest.

name: Life Residue
